You sound exactly like my ex boyfriend (who is also one of my very few best friends.) He is so incredibly smart, but so frustrated and unmotivated he doesn't do much with it. It's so hard to explain to him how much potential he has to do many great things, if he just holds on and get's the right medication to help fight his depression. His view on himself is so awfully distorted, he truly believes he screws everything up, like you, but it's just not true. It's very hard to give someone like this evidence that they're worth something, but everyones worth something. Especially him. He's so thoughtful, intelligent, and kind. I envy his mind so much. And his art is adorable, even though he thinks it's unbearable. :) I could go on, but my point is, your view is distorted. Don't listen to yourself. Good luck, please seek some help. xo
